tool.name: ampvis2 export fasta
tool.description: export sequences from an ampvis2 object and optionally add taxonomy to the fasta header lines.

param.label: Add taxonomy to the fasta header lines.

tool.help:
What it does ============
Export sequences from an ampvis2 object and optionally add taxonomy to the fasta header lines.
The Galaxy tool calls the `amp_export_fasta <https://kasperskytte.github.io/ampvis2/reference/amp_export_fasta.html>`_ function of the ampvis2 package.
Input =====
An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).
In order to work the ampvis2 rds data set needs to contain sequence information.
Output ======
The sequences contained in the input as fasta.
